```{r}
#loading in all libraries needed
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
```

```{r}
#load in the df 
df <- import('en-wikipedia_traffic_200712-201809.csv')

#i have to make a date column so that we can use it for the graph
df_clean <- df %>%
  # Combine columns into a valid Date format
  mutate(Date = as.Date(paste(year, month, '01'), format = '%Y %m %d'))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = df_clean) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Date, y = pagecount_all_views, color = 'red')) 
```
